scenarios.prompt: Two active attacks contact on the same logic tick while one attack remains overlapped for three ticks. Define attack instance IDs, candidate collection and trade/multi-hit policy.

criteria.ownership: Gameplay volumes and interaction classes are data independent of render meshes.
criteria.identity: Duplicate-hit and multi-hit behavior is keyed by stable attack instance/hit index/target policy.
criteria.ordering: Candidates are collected from a logic snapshot before reactions mutate state, making iteration order irrelevant.
